title: Office setup
description: Get your office ready in a few steps. You can skip any step and pick up where you left off later.
office_description: Your office's name as shown in the panel and in e-mails sent to taxpayers.
team_description: Invite your colleagues. The invitation e-mail is sent right away; you can add several people.
team_no_permission: You may not send team invitations. You can skip this step.
taxpayers_description: Upload your taxpayer list as an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. Expected columns: VKN/TCKN, Unvan (title), Vergi dairesi (tax office), E-posta (e-mail).
taxpayers_replace_hint: Choose another file to replace the list.
taxpayers_file_type: Only .xlsx or .csv files can be uploaded.
taxpayers_upload_failed: The file could not be uploaded. Please try again.
taxpayers_load_failed: The uploaded list could not be read.
accounting_description: Choose the accounting program your office uses. Journal exports are prepared in its format.
integrations_description: Integrator connections are set up per taxpayer: once a taxpayer approves your office's request, connect their integrator from the taxpayer's page.
integrations_empty: No approved taxpayers yet. They are listed here as they approve your invitation.
invites_description: Each valid row of the uploaded list receives an e-mail asking them to approve your office.
invites_no_import: No taxpayer list has been uploaded yet. Upload a file in the "Taxpayer list" step to send invitations.
invites_pending: An approval e-mail will be sent to {{valid}} taxpayers
resume_hint: You can stop any time and continue from the setup card on the overview.
source_integrator_body: Invoices arrive automatically from integrators such as QNB or EDM. Connected per taxpayer.
source_agent_body: Uploads the UBL and ZIP files that land in a folder on an office computer.
source_upload_body: Always available: drag and drop the files.
taxpayers_fix_hint: Fix the invalid rows in the table; the list is uploaded and checked again.
accounting_zirve_hint: Journal export template; not verified yet.
